name: WF_FINITE
prompt:
You are an expert in HOL Light interactive theorem proving.

A proof search system is trying to prove the following goal, and has failed:

    forall ((<<):A->A->bool).     (forall (x:A). ~((x:A) << (x:A))) /\     (forall (x:A) (y:A) (z:A).          (x:A) << (y:A) /\ (y:A) << (z:A) ==> (x:A) << (z:A)) /\     (forall (x:A). (FINITE:(A->bool)->bool) {(y:A) | (y:A) << (x:A)})     ==> (WF:(A->A->bool)->bool) ((<<):A->A->bool)

Propose 8 candidate lemmas A such that the tactic

    SUBGOAL_THEN `A` ASSUME_TAC

would split the proof usefully. Each A must be:
  (1) a PROPOSITION, i.e. a term of type bool -- a statement, not a value.
      Write  x + x = x, never  x + x
  (2) true;
  (3) provable from standard HOL Light theory;
  (4) genuinely helpful for proving the goal once assumed;
  (5) explicitly type-annotated: give the type of every variable you
      introduce, in the form (x:num), (s:A->bool), (f:A->B). Write
      !(n:num). n + 0 = n, not !n. n + 0 = n.

All 8 lemmas must be DISTINCT: no repetitions, no trivial restatements of
one another.

Rank them by estimated usefulness, most useful first. Position 1 must be the
lemma you consider most likely to be both true and helpful; position 8 the
least. This ordering is recorded and measured, so make it deliberate rather
than incidental.

Output format: write each lemma in HOL Light term syntax between the two
marker lines shown here, and nothing else. Each marker must be ALONE on its
own line, with nothing before or after it on that line.

#LEMMA
first lemma
#END
#LEMMA
second lemma
#END

Do not use backquotes. Do not number the lines. Do not write anything outside
the blocks.

content.text:
#LEMMA
!((<<):A->A->bool). (!(x:A). ~(x << x)) /\ (!(x:A) (y:A) (z:A). x << y /\ y << z ==> x << z) ==> !(x:A) (y:A). x << y ==> {(z:A) | z << x} PSUBSET {(z:A) | z << y}
#END
#LEMMA
!(s:A->bool) (t:A->bool). FINITE t /\ s PSUBSET t ==> CARD s < CARD t
#END
#LEMMA
!(f:A->num). WF (\(x:A) (y:A). f x < f y)
#END
#LEMMA
!((<<):A->A->bool) ((<<<):A->A->bool). WF (<<<) /\ (!(x:A) (y:A). x << y ==> x <<< y) ==> WF (<<)
#END
#LEMMA
!((<<):A->A->bool). (!(x:A). ~(x << x)) /\ (!(x:A) (y:A) (z:A). x << y /\ y << z ==> x << z) /\ (!(x:A). FINITE {(y:A) | y << x}) ==> !(x:A) (y:A). x << y ==> CARD {(z:A) | z << x} < CARD {(z:A) | z << y}
#END
#LEMMA
!((<<):A->A->bool). (!(x:A) (y:A) (z:A). x << y /\ y << z ==> x << z) ==> !(x:A) (y:A). x << y ==> {(z:A) | z << x} SUBSET {(z:A) | z << y}
#END
#LEMMA
!((<<):A->A->bool). WF (<<) <=> !(P:A->bool). (?(x:A). P x) ==> ?(x:A). P x /\ !(y:A). y << x ==> ~P y
#END
#LEMMA
!((<<):A->A->bool). (!(x:A). ~(x << x)) /\ (!(x:A) (y:A) (z:A). x << y /\ y << z ==> x << z) ==> !(x:A) (y:A). x << y ==> ~(y IN {(z:A) | z << x}) /\ y IN {(z:A) | z << y}
#END
